summary: Complete conceptual review; factual corrections, quizzes and four diagrams validated.
findings: Corrected ETL versus ELT order in article, quiz and dataflow figure.
Replaced retired Sqoop example; clarified bounded/stream processing and non-guaranteed latency/accuracy.
Qualified Kafka replay by retained records/compaction and separated replay from end-to-end exactly-once sink semantics.
Clarified CDC/schema compatibility scope and distinction between Airflow operators and Kubernetes controllers.
Removed unsupported claims of universal brokerautoscaling/tenantisolation/costsavings and clarified managedworkspace/EMRonEKS ownership.
Corrected Airflow→Kafka broker implication; changed Kafka→Spark storage claim to event consumption; added missing Spark output and compacted dataflow layout.
